item.title: OpenBSD SSHGuard Tutorial
item.description: This is a quick look at SSHGuard and how to effectively use it to ban ssh brute force attacks on OpenBSD machines. The sshguard program is an extra layer of security that bans IP addresses that have reached a maximum threshold of failed password attempts. The SSHGuard program can monitor multiple log sources and block based on a threat weighted system. By default SSHGuard will block an IP for 120 seconds and following blocks will increase by a factor of 1.
